description: This source file provides debugging utilities for a Python-based FastAPI project, including memory usage monitoring, garbage collection configuration, and tracing async tasks and OpenTelemetry spans.

methods.name: configure_gc_thresholds()
methods.description: Configures the Python garbage collection thresholds based on environment variable PYTHON_GC_THRESHOLD.

methods.name: get_active_tasks_stats()
methods.description: Returns count and grouping of active asyncio tasks.

methods.name: memory_usage()
methods.description: Reports current process memory usage, cache sizes, and garbage collection status.

methods.name: memory_usage_in_mem_cache( _: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Reports the size of in-memory caches maintained by the proxy server.

methods.name: memory_usage_in_mem_cache_items( _: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Reports the number of items in various in-memory caches.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_memory_summary( _: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Provides a comprehensive summary of memory usage, including process info, cache statuses, and GC stats.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] configure_gc_thresholds_endpoint( _: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), generation_0: int = Query(700, description="Generation 0 threshold (default: 700)"), generation_1: int = Query(10, description="Generation 1 threshold (default: 10)"), generation_2: int = Query(10, description="Generation 2 threshold (default: 10)"), )
methods.description: Endpoint to configure Python GC thresholds dynamically.

methods.name: get_otel_spans()
methods.description: Retrieves collected OpenTelemetry spans for analysis.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_memory_details( _: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), top_n: int = Query(20, description="Number of top object types to return"), include_process_info: bool = Query(True, description="Include process memory info"), )
methods.description: Gathers detailed memory diagnostics, including memory of objects, GC info, and cache sizes.

methods.name: configure_gc_thresholds
methods.description: Utility to set GC thresholds from environment variables.

methods.name: init_verbose_loggers()
methods.description: Initializes verbose loggers based on configuration.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _get_gc_statistics()
methods.description: Gathers stats about the current state and configuration of the garbage collector.

methods.name: Tuple[int,List[Dict[str,Any]]] _get_object_type_counts(top_n: int)
methods.description: Counts and reports the most common object types currently tracked by gc.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _get_uncollectable_objects_info()
methods.description: Returns info about objects that are uncollectable, useful for leak detection.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _get_cache_memory_stats(user_api_key_cache, llm_router, proxy_logging_obj, redis_usage_cache)
methods.description: Calculates memory usage for various caches like API keys, router responses, and logs.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _get_router_memory_stats(llm_router)
methods.description: Provides memory usage details for the LiteLLM router component.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] _get_process_memory_info(worker_pid: int, include_process_info: bool)
methods.description: Uses psutil to get detailed memory info about the current process.
